subject: Operations
title: The Dreamliner Battery Crisis
description: A quick, practical guide to The Dreamliner Battery Crisis.

hook.text: Boeing's 787 Dreamliner was grounded worldwide after lithium-ion batteries caught fire. The entire fleet sat idle.

buildup.text: Boeing outsourced 70% of the Dreamliner's production to global suppliers to reduce costs and speed development.

discovery.text: Parts arrived late, didn't fit, or had quality issues. The battery was sourced through a chain Boeing barely supervised.

twist.text: Over-outsourcing meant Boeing lost visibility and control. When the battery failed, finding the root cause took months.

climax.text: The Dreamliner was delivered 3 years late and billions over budget. Boeing vowed to bring more production in-house.

punchline.text: Outsource the work but not the responsibility.

quiz.question: What caused the Dreamliner's battery problems?
options: A deeply outsourced supply chain with little oversight
